instruction: Candid medium shot of four children standing side-by-side in a sunny park, smiling at the camera. On the left, the boy with glasses (R1) in a yellow t-shirt stands with his arm around the next girl. The girl with curly hair (R3) in a white cardigan and reddish-brown jumpsuit stands next to him, smiling. Beside her, the boy with short brown hair (R5) in a blue denim shirt smiles warmly. On the far right, the girl with dark straight hair (R4) in a dark blue cardigan smiles brightly. Warm sunlight filters through the trees behind them.
elements: R1 places his arm around R3
R3 is the child next to R1 receiving R1's arm-around contact
R1 and R3 stand side-by-side in an arm-around pose
